newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey sells 11 pct of cellular division.
newsitem.headline: Plessey sells 11 pct of cellular division.

text.p: Plessey Corporation has sold a further 11 percent stake in its cellular service provider, Plessey Cellular, to Western Cape province-based Brimstone Investment Corporation Ltd.
It said in a statement on Friday that this brought Brimstone's stake in Plessey Cellular to 26 percent while another black empowerment group, Metropolitan Life, held 20 percent.

"We will now be taking a more active role in strategic planning for Plessey Cellular and would like to help grow the company substantially over the next three years," Brimstone chairman Mustaq Brey said in the statement.
